title: Shorabet Adas (Lentil Soup)
deck: A 30-minute red lentil soup simmered with onion, potatoes, carrots, and cumin, blended until creamy, and served with lemon wedges and pita chips.
vessel: large pot; large stainless steel skillet
credit: Recipe by Laila Ibrahim, from Serious Eats.

notes.title: Lemon-forward
notes.body: Serve with plenty of large lemon wedges — shorabet adas is meant to be bright and lemon-forward.

notes.title: Stock choice
notes.body: Chicken stock adds savoriness to the soup; vegetable stock works well for a vegan version.

notes.title: Make-ahead
notes.body: Leftovers can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 4 days.

tree.detail: on medium-high speed until smooth, about 1 minute (or with an immersion blender)

children.detail: bring to a boil over medium-high heat, reduce heat to a simmer, and cook, covered, until the potatoes, lentils, and carrots are tender, about 15 minutes
stirring occasionally, until lightly golden, about 7 minutes

children.item: 1 large yellow onion (10 ounces; 284 g), finely chopped
children.name: yellow onion

children.item: 10 ounces yellow potatoes (284 g; about 3 small potatoes), peeled and chopped
children.name: yellow potatoes

children.item: 1 cup dried red lentils (7 ounces; 200 g), picked over and rinsed
children.name: dried red lentils

children.item: 6 ounces carrots (170 g; about 2 medium carrots), peeled and chopped
children.name: carrots

children.item: 4 cups (960 ml) homemade or store-bought unsalted chicken or vegetable stock (see notes)
children.name: homemade or store-bought unsalted chicken or vegetable stock

children.item: 3 teaspoons Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume or the same weight
children.name: Diamond Crystal kosher salt

sections.name: pita chips
prep: Line a large plate with paper towels.

tree.detail: immediately after transferring, with salt to taste

children.detail: working in two batches, stirring and flipping often, until golden, 2 to 3 minutes — take care not to let them darken
about 1/4 inch olive oil in a large stainless steel skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering
